# **Who’s That Pokémon\!? A Tectonic Bingo**

![][image1]

## Begins **February 27th at 06:00pm UTC / 01:00pm EST** Ends **March 8th at 08:00pm UTC / 03:00pm EST**

---

## **IMPORTANT INFO**

* **Hiding outside of clan chat during this bingo will result in your team losing 100 POINTS**  
* **Your submission screenshots need to be full-client screenshots**

## Website Info

Link to website: TBA  
(login info can be found pinned to your teams submission channel)

## Newcomers & Split Confirmations

Tectonic splits drops by default \- this means you are required to specify if you can’t split. It is in good practice to confirm in game chat prior to starting group content (i.e raids, nex, etc) that you will be splitting. We hope this won’t be a concern \- but you should take these precautions as you see fit.

---

## **General Rules**

### **Codeword**

Each team will be assigned a unique Codeword. Upon the completion of a tile, that Codeword along with the date and time must be visible on-screen via the “Clan Events” plugin for a screenshot to suffice as evidence. If you can’t use the clan events plugin (i.e you’re a mobile or vanilla client player), you must type the codeword in the chatbox. Teams will be given their Codewords at the start of the event.

*Example of “Clan Events” plugin configuration:*  
![][image2]

### **Usage of other accounts (Alting)**

For those of you who have multiple accounts, only one account’s submissions will count.

#### **Allowed**

* Scouting (raid layouts, wildy cave alarm, etc)  
* Scaling  
* Resupplying  
* Other QoL (Please be reasonable)

#### **Disallowed**

* DPS increasing uses; for example, tanking, spec transferring, and other “dolo” methods.

*Alts are not allowed in any way that would **significantly** benefit your team.*

*This includes using non-team players for “altable” activities. For example, if you have a friend slap on full justiciar and a bulwark and tank bandos for you, that’s basically the same as using an alt. But if you wanted to do CoX or ToB with a friend, that’s not an issue as long as they aren’t blatantly feeding you points to increase your drop rate.*

### **Drop Specific Rules**

**Item drops will only count towards the team of the player who received that drop**.  
**(CoX, ToB, GWD, etc)**

Normal clan specific rules still apply to PvM, **we split by DEFAULT** unless explicitly stated otherwise by the individual.

If you decide to go on a Bandos trip with someone from another team and you get a pair of tassets, those will count for your board and your board only. So, you may do content with other CC members that are not on your team, but do so at your own risk.

As much as we’ll try to enforce the rules, the integrity of this bingo will depend on the integrity of the players. We trust you all to follow the rules, given that this is a clan of friends and we want a fair game. Any players/teams found to be cheating may be disqualified from this bingo/future bingo’s. You will not receive your buy-in/winnings if you are caught cheating and kicked from the bingo.

### **Prizes**

#### **The Bingo Pot is 900m (May be subject to change).**

Split TBD via polling

#### **In the case of a tie**

The first team to acquire that number of points wins. 

### **Important Notes (Q\&A)**

#### **Why do I need to send a picture of my bank?**

For things like caskets (clue scrolls are fine), WT or Tempoross, we have no way to verify if you had stacked up caskets/permits beforehand. **If you have not sent a picture there is a chance we cannot verify your drop to be legitimate.** *(Please encourage all of your team members to do so)*

#### **Chat notifications**

You will need this setting enabled for this bingo:  
![][image3]

#### **Automatic Screenshots**

You may find this setting in the “Screenshot” plugin helpful when grinding the barrows tile  
(Don’t forget to turn it off post-bingo lol)  
![][image4]  
---

## **Base Tile Rules/Descriptions:**

* **All tiles have partial and full completion points (Part A & Part B)**  
* **You will have access to both halves of the tiles and may submit for Part B before finishing Part A, however, you can only claim points for Part B if you have completed Part A**  
* **Lines also have point values: 15 points per line**  
* **All raid, colosseum, and doom tiles have a 2 hour freeze period. This means you are not allowed to obtain items for or submit their content for the first 2 hours of bingo.**  
* **Hotkey tips: Ctrl+F to bring up a search bar and search the tile you need**

## **Fine print**

Be a responsible gamer. Take regular breaks, and try not to play 18-hour days.   
We may adjust tiles on the board, based on how the bingo goes. 

If you have any questions or would like clarifications for any tile, please feel free to ask in bingo-general

Be nice and respect the bingo mods\! They’re taking time out of their day to help during this event.
